# Culina

> Culina is the all-in-one platform for shared commercial kitchens and the food
> entrepreneurs (makers) inside them. Operators manage bookings, members,
> compliance, invoicing, spaces, and announcements; makers book kitchen time,
> track certifications, cost recipes, launch AI-built storefronts, find grants,
> and grow. Built on Cloudflare (D1, R2, Workers AI).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://culina.life/): What Culina is and who it's for — shared kitchens and their makers.
- [Features](https://culina.life/features): Booking, compliance, storefronts, invoicing, grants, and community.
- [Find a Kitchen](https://culina.life/find-a-kitchen): The Kitchen Discovery Network — find a licensed shared commercial kitchen near you.
- [About](https://culina.life/about): Our mission to help food businesses start, run, and grow.
- [Privacy](https://culina.life/privacy): How we handle your data.

## For operators (shared-kitchen owners)

- Online booking and a color-coded calendar across stations.
- Member management, leads/inquiries CRM, and a retention radar that flags at-risk members.
- Compliance tracking that auto-blocks booking on expired documents.
- Automated monthly invoicing and Stripe Connect payouts.

## For makers (food entrepreneurs)

- Book kitchen time and equipment by the hour, day, or month.
- Recipe & Food Cost Lab, AI storefront builder, grant finder, and learning hub.
- Keep certifications current and sell online with a free storefront.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Culina is a real, production SaaS at https://culina.life.
- Sign-up is free to start; operators and makers each get a tailored dashboard.
